summary: Leusink Aardappelen is a family-run potato peeling business in Deurningen, Overijssel, Netherlands. It cuts fresh fries and peels and cuts potatoes for cafeterias, snack bars and other hospitality businesses, and also sells table potatoes and frying oil. It began as an arable farm and has worked with potatoes for more than 40 years.
ownership: Family-owned, run by Henk Leusink and Arno Leusink
products: Fresh fries, with or without skin, cut sizes 10, 12 and 14 mm
Table potatoes in 5 kg and 10 kg packs
markets: Restaurants, fish shops and other hospitality businesses
Private customers collecting at the shop
